_meta.keys: wafer.constants.CLASSES (8 defect patterns + none); checked by tests/test_factory.py
_meta.note: Pattern-to-cause mapping is a triage heuristic, not a diagnosis: several tools can produce the same pattern. source = where the association comes from. 'not read in full' = taken from a search excerpt; open the paper and confirm before quoting it.

Center.cause: Radial non-uniformity at the wafer centre: CMP uniformity problem, or irregular RF operation / unusual liquid flow
Center.machine: CMP polisher or CVD deposition chamber
Center.recommended_action: Check CMP pad/head pressure profile and deposition uniformity monitors for the affected tool
Center.source: KAIST College of Engineering research webzine (centre circular pattern from a CMP uniformity problem), https://breakthroughs.kaist.ac.kr/sub02/view/id/219; arXiv 2607.00961, root-cause table adapted from Shin et al. 2024 (irregular RF operation or unusual liquid flow), https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.00961. Not read in full.

Donut.cause: Ring of failures at mid radius: residue left after photoresist cleaning/strip
Donut.recommended_action: Check resist strip and post-strip clean recipes and residue inspection for the affected tool
Donut.source: arXiv 2607.00961, Table 1 adapted from Shin et al. 2024, https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.00961 (residue that resists removal during photoresist cleaning). Not read in full.

Edge-Loc.cause: Localised failures on part of the edge: irregular annealing temperature or load-lock valve impurities; handling damage at the edge
Edge-Loc.machine: Anneal (thermal) chamber load-lock, or wafer handling
Edge-Loc.recommended_action: Check anneal temperature uniformity and load-lock valve condition; inspect edge handling contact points
Edge-Loc.source: arXiv 2607.00961, Table 1 adapted from Shin et al. 2024, https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.00961, citing Hansen et al. 1997 (irregular temperature annealing or load-lock valve impurities). Not read in full.

Edge-Ring.cause: Failures around the full wafer edge: edge temperature or plasma non-uniformity (RTP temperature regulation, edge etch/deposition)
Edge-Ring.machine: Plasma etch chamber (edge/focus ring) or RTP thermal chamber
Edge-Ring.recommended_action: Hold the tool; inspect focus/edge ring wear and edge etch-rate uniformity
Edge-Ring.source: arXiv 2607.00961, root-cause table adapted from Shin et al. 2024 (anomalous temperature regulation during RTP or cold process), https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.00961. Not read in full. The etch link is our triage assumption.

Loc.cause: A localised cluster of failures away from the edge: particle or contamination event
Loc.machine: Any process tool; often deposition or lithography
Loc.recommended_action: Run particle check on tools the lot visited; review defect inspection images
Loc.source: arXiv 2607.00961, Table 1 adapted from Shin et al. 2024, https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.00961 (entry seen only in part: vacuum-pressure differences). Not read in full; cause is our triage assumption.

Near-full.cause: Almost the whole wafer fails: a gross process failure (missed or wrong step, mis-processed recipe)
Near-full.machine: Process step failure; check recipe and lithography exposure
Near-full.recommended_action: Stop the lot; verify recipe and step history before processing more wafers
Near-full.source: Triage heuristic; no citation yet (searched: no source found giving a Near-full cause)

Random.cause: Failures spread randomly over the wafer: background particle contamination
Random.recommended_action: Check cleanroom particle counts and wet-clean bath chemistry
Random.source: US Patent 10,922,807 (cleanroom particles as a random cause spread evenly over the wafer), https://patents.google.com/patent/US10922807; Minitab blog 'Enhance Integrated Circuit Yields with a Wafer Map' (random defect density tracks cleanroom cleanliness), https://blog.minitab.com/en/enhance-circuit-yields-wafer-map. Not read in full.

Scratch.cause: A line of failures: mechanical scratch from handling-robot misalignment or careless handling, or CMP micro-scratches
Scratch.recommended_action: Inspect CMP pad conditioner and robot end-effector for debris
Scratch.source: US Patent 5,913,105 (scratches from mechanical contact: handling-robot misalignment or careless handling), https://patents.google.com/patent/US5913105; US Patent 9,442,077 (CMP-induced scratches), https://patents.google.com/patent/US9442077. Not read in full.
